findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure XML parser configuration in lxml
 * @description XML parsers created without secure defaults could be vulnerable to XXE attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-xml-parser
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Look for XMLParser creation without secure settings
  call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember("XMLParser").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("html").getMember("HTMLParser").getACall()
select call, "XML parser created without explicit secure configuration (consider disabling external entities)"
findings.hypothesis: XML parsers created without secure defaults could be vulnerable to XXE attacks

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous function usage in lxml
 * @description Usage of eval, exec, or other dangerous functions could lead to code injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/dangerous-functions
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially dangerous function that could execute arbitrary code"
findings.hypothesis: Check for dangerous function usage like eval, exec, or unsafe deserialization that could lead to code injection

message.text: Potentially dangerous function that could execute arbitrary code
